absent.reason: mid_run_stop replays an abort while a tool runs; an interrupt settles the turn through the same abort and idle path.
The driver refuses a second prompt while a turn is active before it sends any request, so no server frame takes part.
The normalizer test malformed_and_cross_session_events_are_bounded and the event stream decoder test cover malformed and oversized events without a server.
Steering sends one more prompt_async request during the turn, which the driver test external_session_lifecycle_never_stops_the_external_server covers.
